{{Quote|Who are you?|Lolo Essumon, when he and Kuce confronted the heroes of Cularin|<ref name="TAUT" />}}
'''Kuce''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who worked as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lolo Essumon]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Kuce and Essumon engaged in a brawl with a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] in the residential section of Burnout.

==Biography==
Kuce was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zham Hlar]] in the [[Thaereian system]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Kuce worked as the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lolo Essumon]] and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the pair had established a well-honed working relationship.<ref name="TAUT" />

Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Essumon and Kuce spotted the [[heroes of Cularin]], renowned freelance agents from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], passing through the residential section of Burnout. Noting the group to be outsiders, the pair confronted the group, with Kuce jumping across from the top of one residential [[cube]] to another to reveal his presence to the freelancers.<ref name="TAUT" />

{{RPG|''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]''}}
As Kuce watched on, the freelance operatives negotiated with Essumon for information pertaining to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]], a [[Thaereian Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who had stolen a [[PU-36 modulator chip|key component]] from the freelancers' [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. After the one of agents attempted a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] against Essumon, Kuce punched the individual. A fight then broke out, resulting in the Bothan and Wookiee duo being defeated by the freelance agents.<ref name="TAUT" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Kuce had [[Color/Legends|dark]]-colored [[Hair/Legends|fur]]. He patiently and obedient followed the instructions of his employer Lolo Essumon. He also disliked members of the Trandoshan [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TAUT" />

==Powers and abilities==
Proficient in the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] [[Enhance Attribute]] and [[Battlemind]], Kuce was also adept in the use of the Force to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] things, to [[Force healing/Legends|heal himself]] and to [[Tutaminis|dissipate energy]]. Though he did not understand [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], the Wookiee was fluent in the [[Language/Legends|language]] [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] and could comprehend [[Bothese|Bothan]].<ref name="TAUT" />

Working closely with Essumon, Kuce agreed to adhere to a pre-prepared set of instructions when in difficult situations. If the Bothan repeated back a phrase spoken by another individual, Kuce was to immediately attack the other party. Kuce also had standing orders to [[Death/Legends|take]] Essumon's life if the Bothan gave away information without receiving payment, as a safeguard against another party utilizing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to coerce information from Essumon involuntarily. Another pre-agreed combat strategy of theirs was for Kuce to hold off from attacking an enemy while Essumon threw a [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenade]], then to strike in the aftermath of Essumon's volley.<ref name="TAUT" />

==Equipment==
Kuce wore a [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and was equipped with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and a pair of Force-imbued [[combat gloves]] which he could utilize to deflect attacks from [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapons.<ref name="TAUT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuce appeared in ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] module written by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]]. The adventure was published in [[2002]] as the second instalment of the [[Looking In trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.<ref name="TAUT" />

In ''The Air Up Thaere'', the players roleplay as the heroes of Cularin and it is possible for a fight to break out, pitting Kuce and Essumon against the player characters, although it is also possible for the pair to interact with the players peacefully. If combat does break out, Kuce tried his hardest to provoke any Trandoshan player characters into single combat. If Kuce and Essumon incapacitate the players, the pair loot any stun [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] that the player characters are carrying and also, if the players are of a high roleplay experience tier, any lightsabers. In the event that the freelance agents incapacitate Essumon, Kuce flies into a rage and cannot be placated; if Kuce is immobilized Essumon surrenders to the player characters immediately.<ref name="TAUT" />
